challenge.method: Compare empty brackets with explicit numeric dimensions and the bounded TO examples. Analyze the capacity guidance for declaration initializers against the separate excess-item example as a possible overgeneralization.
challenge.results: The empty-bracket form has one dimension with lower bound one. Fixed-size arrays can also be one-dimensional, and variable size is unavailable with multiple dimensions in the described declaration model. One section disallows an over-capacity value list while another documents ignoring surplus values in one example. That discrepancy remains outside this dimensional claim.

limitations: This is a declaration-level claim. The publisher’s excess-initializer examples and assignment behavior are outside its truth conditions.
